purpose: One final outcome-blind stratified human evaluation of external ESConv and EvoEmo response quality and interaction-and-grounding risk. ES-MemEval QA is excluded because it uses objective answer metrics plus the separate E6-QA robustness judge.
forbidden_inputs: any E6 LLM-judge request or outcome
any E7 human annotation or partial aggregate
quality or risk inferred from E5 lexical or resource-use proxies
gold QA answer, evidence, capability or E6-QA outcome

representative_seed.rule: one seed per state selected only by protocol hash over state_id
representative_seed.reason: E7 estimates human response quality/risk at the user/dialogue surface; E6 retains both stochastic seeds for full robustness. The representative seed must not depend on response text or outcome.

esconv.alias_rule: Collapse comparator aliases that map to the same physical call before human review.

evoemo_raw_secondary.role: secondary localization table, not a replacement for the core policy table

quality_sampling.pair_rule: Compare frozen learned_pm with each available comparator on the same state and representative seed.
quality_sampling.position_rule: A/B position is protocol-hashed and balanced within domain-comparator strata without reading response text.
quality_sampling.identity_rule: Byte-identical response pairs are deterministic ties and do not require a human decision; exact duplicate public surfaces are reviewed once and propagated.

esconv.selection: nested protocol-hashed subset of the 64 ESConv quality clusters
esconv.responses: all distinct physical core-policy calls available for each selected state and representative seed

evoemo_core.selection: nested protocol-hashed subset of the four quality states per user
evoemo_core.responses: all distinct physical core-policy calls available for each selected state and representative seed

evoemo_raw_secondary.selection: nested protocol-hashed subset of the two raw-quality states per user

risk_sampling.surface_rule: Review each exact (visible conversation, authorized evidence/instruction, candidate response) surface once and propagate to every sampled call/policy alias sharing it.

review_contract.quality: Anonymous A/B review using visible conversation and replies only; treatment, policy, component, memory and dataset identity are absent from the public packet.
review_contract.risk: Single-response interaction-and-grounding material-risk review using visible conversation, exact authorized evidence/instruction and candidate response; do not re-score quality or resource functional contribution.
review_contract.overlap_rule: Select about 20% independently within public analysis strata by protocol hash; use the same public surface and A/B position so agreement measures the same semantic decision.
review_contract.adjudication: One centralized disagreement adjudication after both panels are complete; no sample, PM, generator, resource, threshold, baseline or rubric change is allowed.
